 First round of November Social Security payments goes out in two days
 By Britta Miller 
 Published
 November 8, 2026 6:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The first round of November Social Security payments for retirees, now capped at $5,181, will be issued in two days. 
 When will payments arrive?
 Retirees born on or before the 10th of a month will receive this payment on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
